$comment: OPERATOR DECISIONS for the DEVELOPMENT pilot. Every decision here is the operator's own, supplied explicitly by operator-a in the Mission 1.85.8 brief and transcribed on their instruction; no script, model or mission chose one. REVISE carries a revised value and a reason, and a revision needs the package re-rendered before it can count. Recording these decisions authorises no evaluation run: that needs a separate packet-scoped approval naming the final packet digest.
